name: knowledge_circle_user
label: Knowledge Circle User Table
description: The knowledge circle user table is used for related queries and report queries related to the knowledge base.

fields.name: knowledge_circle_id
fields.description: Knowledge circle ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: User/role/group UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Distinguish between the approver and member fields (approver: approver; member: member), used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the knowledge_circle_id, UUID, type, auth_type fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
